answer: Reputation decays when work stops. An identity that idles loses standing on a fixed half-life, so a stockpiled cipher of old accounts is worth less every week. Link two identities and a river of shared history resets to zero. Replay the submission log on every audit: duplicates show as identical bytes, not as similar names. What breaks first is the marble ledger of stale reputation, and that is exactly the failure to design for.
